blocks.text: Online research ko maqsad aur zaroori maloomat ki qisam ke hisab se mukhtalif types (qismon) mein baanta ja sakta hai. Online research ki sab se aam qismein yeh hain:

items: General Information Research (aam maloomat ki research): kisi topic ki bunyadi maloomat dhoondna. Is se topic ka overview (sarsari khaaka) ya main points samajh aate hain. Google jaise search engines se aise articles, blog posts ya videos mil jati hain jo aam ilm dete hain.

Academic Research (taleemi/ilmi research): parhai ke liye scholarly (ilmi, mahireen ki likhi) maloomat dhoondna. Is mein educational websites, libraries ya databases se kitabein, research papers ya articles talash kiye jate hain. Yeh tafseeli aur reliable maloomat deti hai jo aksar experts (mahireen) ki likhi hoti hai.

Market Research (bazaar ki research): businesses aur entrepreneurs (naya karobar shuru karne wale) is se market trends (bazaar ke rujhanat), customer behavior (gahakon ka rawayya) aur competition (muqabla) samajhte hain. Is se karobar naye products ya services launch karne ke bare mein soch samajh kar faisle karte hain.
Fact-Checking Research (haqaiq ki jaanch): yeh dekhna ke maloomat durust hai ya nahi. Is mein kai reliable sources check kar ke facts ki sachai pakki ki jati hai.

Health Research (sehat ki research): sehat ke masail, medical treatments (ilaj) ya healthcare services ki maloomat dhoondna. Reliable health websites aur medical journals ke zariye log alamaat (symptoms), ilaj aur sehatmand rehne ke tareeqe seekhte hain.

blocks.prompt: Online research ki mukhtalif qismein aur un ke maqsad misalon ke saath bataiye. (Long question 1)
blocks.explanation: General Information Research: kisi topic ka overview lena; maslan Google par 'renewable energy' talash kar ke aam articles aur videos dekhna. Academic Research: parhai ke liye experts ki likhi tafseeli maloomat; maslan science project ke liye library ya database se pollution par research papers. Market Research: karobar ke liye market trends, customers aur competition samajhna; maslan dukaan naya product launch karne se pehle dekhti hai ke log kya khareed rahe hain. Fact-Checking Research: maloomat ki sachai jaanchna; maslan social media ki kisi viral khabar ko kai reliable news sources se milana. Health Research: sehat ki maloomat; maslan reliable health website ya medical journal se kisi bimari ki alamaat aur ilaj parhna. (Misalein kitab ki tareef par mabni hain; kuch hamari taraf se samjhane ke liye hain.)

items: Paanch qismein: General Information, Academic, Market, Fact-Checking, Health research.
Academic research experts ki likhi tafseeli maloomat deti hai; fact-checking kai sources se sachai jaanchti hai.
